mechanism_narrative: A rising GDP indicates strong economic demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the 60-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate suggests labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by >0.5pp in one month
failure_condition: If the unemployment rate rises but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment increases but the unemployment rate also rises, it indicates potential labor market inefficiencies, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If both payroll employment and unemployment rate increase but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate indicates tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the federal funds rate is above 4% but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests strong supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If industrial production increases but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in CPI suggests higher inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% in one month
failure_condition: If CPI increases sharply but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts increase but retail sales fall, it indicates an imbalance in demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If housing starts increase while retail sales fall but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP during an early-cycle expansion suggests robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is strong but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.
